integration.behavior: Pi v1.1.0 source is the baseline. Nyan renamed the product identity (executable, packages, environment, directories, identifiers), removed Pi-operated service defaults and Pi-only compatibility aliases, and enforces functional layers.
localChanges: product identity renamed to nyan; see .agents/notes/implemented/architecture/2026-10-11-nyan-productization.md
layered architecture with executable checks; see .agents/notes/implemented/architecture/2026-10-11-nyan-layered-architecture.md
upstream organization governance, release automation, Nix packaging and the Pi development assistant removed
knownLimits: committed native prebuilds and doom.wasm were built from the pre-rename sources and should be rebuilt before release
a future upstream sync must be applied as a rename-aware merge, not a file overwrite
experimental and example code remains candidate code until a Nyan entry path verifies it
